description.zh:
WAF防护策略类型，取值：

- waf_group：Web基础防护。

- custom_acl：自定义防护策略。

- whitelist：白名单。

- ip_blacklist：IP黑名单。

- region_block：区域封禁。

- bot：Bot管理。
description.en:
The type of the WAF mitigation policy. Valid values:

- waf_group: Basic Web Protection.

- custom_acl: custom mitigation policy.

- whitelist: whitelist.

- ip_blacklist: IP blacklist.

- region_block: Location Blacklist.

- bot: bot management.

description.zh: 防护策略名称。支持输入中文字符、英文字符（大小写）、数字（0~9）及下划线（_），最大输入64个字符。
description.en: The Policy Name of the mitigation policy. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters (uppercase and lowercase), digits (0 to 9), and underscores (_). The name can be up to 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
防护策略状态，取值：

- on：开启。

- off：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the mitigation policy. Valid values:

- on: enabled.

- off: disabled.

description.zh:
设置当前策略是否为默认策略，取值：

- default：默认策略。

- custom：非默认策略。
description.en:
Specifies whether the current policy is the default policy. Valid values:

- default: default policy.

- custom: non-default policy.

descriptions.zh:
> 
> - 单用户调用频率：20次/秒。
> - 请求方式：支持POST请求。
> - 边缘WAF防护会在客户端请求的Cookie、Query String、Header中添加参数以实现JS/滑块验证，请确保您的源站可接受新增的参数，详见：[参数注入的详细说明](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/edge-security-acceleration/dcdn/user-guide/overview-of-waf#section-edge-waf-param-inject)
descriptions.en:
> 
> - The maximum number of times that each user can call this operation per second: 20.
> - Request method: POST requests are supported.
> - Edge WAF protection adds parameters to the Cookie, Query String, and Header of client requests to implement JavaScript verification and slider CAPTCHA verification. Make sure that your origin server can accept the added parameters. For more information, see [Parameter injection details](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/edge-security-acceleration/dcdn/user-guide/overview-of-waf#section-edge-waf-param-inject).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn create-dcdn-waf-policy --policy-name policy_test --policy-type default --policy-status on --defense-scene waf_group --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn CreateDcdnWafPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyType default --PolicyName policy_test --PolicyStatus on --DefenseScene waf_group
